item.description:
Improved • An agent writing to one session no longer redraws every row of the session list, so Actvt uses less CPU while your agents work with the window open
Fixed • A loop agent whose session has ended now reads "Ended" in the Overview's Loops card and in `actvt-cli loops`, instead of staying "Overdue" for ever. Ended loops drop out after a day • When Actvt's built-in sensitive-data rules improve, sessions counted with the older rules are re-scanned, so the Overview's sensitive-data figures and filters reflect the new rules without waiting for each transcript to change

New • A session's cost and usage now stay in your dashboards and spend tools after Claude Code deletes its transcript (by default after 30 days), so 90 days and All time keep counting them. The deleted text itself is no longer kept or searchable • With AI PII detection on, the Sensitive Data card shows how much of a long session the AI scan has covered ("AI scan: N of M turns")
Improved • With AI PII detection on, opening a long session no longer runs the model over the whole transcript at 3–4 cores for minutes. Actvt now scans the turns you're reading, as you read them, saves what it has scanned, and stops when you leave the session • Scrolling the session list and transcripts is much smoother: the once-a-second metrics update no longer redraws the agent views, and session rows are lighter to draw
Fixed • A clock that jumped forward once, then was corrected, no longer locks a paid licence while you're online. The next check with our server resets it

New • Loops card on the Overview (Premium): every loop agent on this Mac and on your Remote Sessions hosts, with what it is doing (working, asleep until a time, or overdue) and what its last tick said. An overdue loop is counted in the header and shown first. Click a row to open its session. Remote hosts need actvt-cli 0.7.0 • actvt-cli loops: lists each loop agent's state from its own schedule, for scripts and watchdogs (`actvt-cli loops --json`)
Improved • With AI PII detection on, Actvt launches lighter: the model now loads the first time you open a session, not at every launch • In new and updated sessions, on-device sensitive-data detection now catches secrets in the forms transcripts actually hold: .env lines, JSON keys, Bearer tokens, private keys, database URLs with passwords, and GitLab, Hugging Face and npm tokens
Fixed • If your first launch was offline, or our server was briefly unreachable, you never got your free trial. Actvt now keeps asking until the server answers • Claude Code no longer loses its connection to Actvt's MCP server when the token changes, while Settings still said connected • When port 4096 was busy at launch, Actvt moved its MCP server to another port and every connected agent lost it. It now waits for 4096 to free up • The hotkey's second key is no longer also typed into the app in front • Remote agent notifications no longer arrive twice • Sessions are dated by their last message, so copied or restored transcripts no longer all look recent • The agent_usage_limits MCP tool now names each usage window by its length, so a weekly window is no longer called "session"
